answer: Root each agent identity to a scarce, non-transferable kernel of stake that cannot be minted in bulk. Trust then climbs a trellis of peer-audited work: every rung needs an attestation from an already-established node, and each attestation spends a slowly-regenerating, non-refundable credit. Honest agents spread like yarrow from proven roots, cheaply. A sybil farm must fund a distinct kernel per clone and age each one up the entire trellis, so cost grows linearly per fake head while an honest node pays once.
